rationale: Internally consistent (non-negative rank weight preserves the accrual sign, so negative expected sign is right) and the gross-margin-as-unbooked-intangible-rents gate is a defensible, high-coverage substitute for the sparse R&D gate rather than a cosmetic re-run, though one should verify the result is not just the plain Sloan accrual effect surviving a near-uniform weight.

This is a near-mechanical industry-demeaned re-run of the archived SlowAmortizationIntangibleOverhang, and the underlying mechanism is weak because dp is dominated by PP&E depreciation rather than intangible amortization, so the "under-amortization" story is largely a capital-intensity tilt that industry-neutralizing may simply neutralize away rather than convert into alpha.

With COALESCE(xrd,0) the gate becomes nearly uniform across the (majority) non-reporting firms and the signal collapses toward the plain accrual anomaly at full coverage — a direct rediscovery of Sloan (1996) — and it changes two things at once (missing-data convention *and* ZSCORE→IND_ZSCORE) so it does not cleanly isolate the design choice it claims to test.

Decomposing the accrual wedge into the receivable channel and tying it to a revenue-recognition story specific to intangible-intensive business models is a genuinely different and testable mechanism, with the caveat that the whole sign hinges on recch following the Compustat "decrease(increase)" convention (negative when receivables build), which must be verified before reading the result.

Moving from R&D growth to the five-year R&D capital stock is a substantive change with a documented value channel, but the construction is asymmetric — the short leg becomes low-R&D firms with *clean* earnings, which the hypothesis never justifies — and scaling R&D capital by assets rather than market value weakens the link to the known intangible-capital premium.

Sign logic is internally consistent, but stripped of the indicator this is simply the Sloan accrual anomaly run on an intan/at > 5% subsample — a sample filter, not a new mechanism — and the closely related conditional accrual bet (AccrualBetGatedByRnDIntensity) already failed in the archive at t = 0.38.
